_comment: Per-weapon grip tuning, keyed by weapon folder basename. grip_offset: palm-frame axes per side (X fingers-forward, Y toward thumb, Z palm normal), units; CLI --grip-offset overrides. arm_dir: forearm/elbow direction in MODEL space per side, toward the player — pins the arm for weapons whose original wrist-parent bone runs along the barrel (arm would otherwise reach into the muzzle); CLI --arm-dir overrides. CSO two-handed guns are Y-flipped vs Valve viewmodels, so their player direction is -Y (down -Z).
